notes.title: Announcing Greenhaven Realms - a fantasy medieval Idle RPG
notes.content:
Greenhaven Realms is a fantasy medieval Idle RPG where players embark on epic adventures. Engage in thrilling combats, craft powerful items, gather resources, mine for treasures, trade goods, and explore vast lands. Build your kingdom and shape your destiny in the enchanting world of Greenhaven.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3123700/Greenhaven_Realms__Idle_RPG/

notes.title: Perfomance Test
notes.content:
Hey, we know that some of you got problems with fps after 20-40 minutes of gameplay, so we're launching Beta Branch of the game with potential fixes.
To get access right click dev_me on steam, select properties and then beta-versions, enter "betabetabetabeta" and download this version. 
I'd recommend you to start a new game.
I'm waiting for your feedback.

P.S. only available on Windows

notes.title: Closed Beta test just begin!
notes.content:
And soooo ːsteamhappyː
I sent the keys to random people who filled out the form on the site.

Important Beta Information:
1. Many game elements are available immediately, without the need for PC upgrades.
2. Many elements do not yet have their own sounds when clicking
3. The game can have a large number of bugs and imbalances, so I will be glad to hear your feedback ːsteamhappyː

Your information about bugs and wishes can be left through the in-game button or on the Steam Discussions.

Enjoy the game ːsteamhappyː
